description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:49-53 (# Limitations) says: "A single bettertls path-building corner case (pathbuilding::tc60) is documented as a known divergence; closing it is a 1.0 release blocker tracked under PKIX-lwr9.4." CHANGELOG [0.3.1] simultaneously claims build_first_valid_path "closes the consumer-ergonomics gap surfaced by PKIX-lwr9.4 / BetterTLS tc60". Either tc60 IS resolved (CHANGELOG view) or it ISN'T (Limitations view) — can't be both. Two consequences: (a) users reading the rustdoc will think the crate has a known correctness bug at 1.0 when the upstream story is that the helper resolves it; (b) when 1.0 actually ships, this stale text will look like a missed line in the audit and erode trust. Decide: is the residual build_path divergence a documented limitation ("build_path is single-shot; use build_first_valid_path for cross-signed pools") or a release blocker? Rewrite the Limitations bullet accordingly. The bettertls fixture README has the same dual framing (line 49-72 vs CHANGELOG line 28-30).
title: Limitations section claims tc60 still a 1.0 blocker but 0.3.1 ships the resolution
